extracted.name: Earl Grey Shortbread Cookies
extracted.description: Great recipe for Earl Grey Shortbread Cookies.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 Cup minus 1 Tablespoon granulated white sugar
instruction_lines: Soft together the flour and salt. Whisk in the contents of the teabags.
Cream together the sugar and butter. Add the vanilla and mix.
Combine with the dry ingredients until a dough forms.
Chill the dough for at least 1 hour.
Roll the dough between 2 pieces if parchment paper with a rolling pin until it’s 1cm thick.
Cut out the dough with a cookie cutter.
Place the cut out dough on a lined baking tray and refrigerate it.
Allow them to cool on the tray for 5 minutes, them remove and place on a wire rack to cool completely.
